Road conditions

  • (803)896-9621-Road conditions/ construction
  • http://www.scdot.org/getting/roadcondition.shtml (Current Road Conditions)

When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" wide,
  • Over 13'6" high,
  • Trailer over 53' long

Special Information Needed

  • Length of trailer and overhang

Times Of Movement

  • Sunrise to sunset, Mon.-Sat. For standard issue

Weekend travel:

  • Loads 14' wide or less may travel sunrise to sunset on Saturday. Loads 16’ wide may travel 9am-3pm on Saturday
  • Travel prohibited on the following holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas. Movement prohibited from noon before each holiday until noon following each holiday.
  • Permit office sill be closed on these holidays plus President’s Day and the day after Thanksgiving.
  • Curfews: Loads 14’ wide & mobile homes are not to be moved over state highways near urban areas between 7-9am & 3-6pm on school days & 4:30-6pm on other days.

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • http://www.dot.state.sc.us/doing/pdfs/OSOW_Guidelinesfor_movement.pdf
  • On 2-lane highways:
  • Width over 12' up to 14'- 1 front (cannot move over state highways in and in close proximity of large urban areas from 7-9am or 3-6pm schools days or 7-9am or 4:30-6pm other days)
  • Width over 14' to 16'- 2 (front & rear); must be moved Mon.-Sat. from 9am-3pm school days & 9am-4pm other days. Must travel on four-lane highways. Must be the only vehicle on any bridge 18’ wide or less.
  • Width over 16'(requires approval of county resident engineers and then state Oversize Permit Department)-3 (2 front & 1 rear)
  • Height 13’6” and over-state determines if pilot is required (with height pole)
  • Rear overhang of 15' on a less than 48' trailer; 10' on 48' & 53' trailers- rear escort & flags (or an amber light)

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • General: Not specified
  • Signs: “OVERSIZE LOAD” or “WIDE LOAD” sign on front and/or rear
  • Lights: Rotating amber beacon or light displayed on top of vehicle
  • Flags: Non specified
  • Additional equipment: Not specified

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • Not specified
